newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom sale may include tranche for ally.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom sale may include tranche for ally.

text.p: The 26 percent of Portugal Telecom, which the government is planning to float later this year, could include a stake for an eventual partner, the country's deputy finance minister said.
He said that the government could send to parliament this month draft legislation to alter the law and let the state's stake in the telecommunications concern drop below 50 percent.
At present, the state holds 51 percent and the law must be changed before it can sell more.
Teixeira dos Santos said that the flotation would probably take place in September to avoid coming to the market too soon after the planned sale of shares in state electricity concern EDP.
"It will probably be in September," he said.
Teixeira dos Santos said that part of the stake could go to a company, or companies, forming the international alliance that Portugal Telecom is seeking.
A decision on the alliance is expected around the end of the month.
He reaffirmed that the state would continue with a 25 percent stake which would be enough to exercise a high degree of control over the company.
